tier_semantics: Aggregate exact MPN across all references before scaling board build. Select highest published minimum that covers required pieces, after explicit MOQ/multiple rounding. No interpolated or inferred discount. No cheaper full-reel tier used for cut tape. Published final cut-tape tier is retained unchanged beyond its minimum; no additional discount is inferred. No Digi-Reel selected.

summary_semantics.known_quantity_matching_subtotal: Priced lines purchasable in the required piece count; excludes unpriced lines and the3 full-lot lines.
summary_semantics.known_consumed_inventory_value_subtotal: Value of fitted parts at the selected published purchase tier. Includes allocation of full-lot unit cost but is NOT the money required to purchase a small batch.
summary_semantics.known_published_purchase_cash_subtotal: Cost of all priced purchase quantities including MOQ excess. Still incomplete because10 exact MPNs and manufacture extras are unpriced. Availability and tariffs unqualified.
